**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount`, so it threw | Read both keys |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined` now, not `false` | Treat it as off |

The 8 warnings are still there. All are noise from the bumped deps, in files this repo does not have, like `src/legacy/adapter.js`. Nothing to fix here.
